label: MICRA indexation rate once the stepped increases end
applies: Annual adjustment to both MICRA noneconomic damages limits after the ten stepped increases are complete
movesWhen: Applies on 1 January of each year beginning 1 January 2034
note: This is why the MICRA limit has no fixed value at any future date. After 2033 the amount is a function of an index rather than a schedule of steps, so a reserve or internal guideline naming a single figure is naming something the statute moves annually without amending itself.
author: Aaron Bollinger
